corpus.retrieval_corpus: every stored play of the model version (all splits); the query play is excluded

environment.client: Python psycopg 3 on the host, TCP to the container port (localhost); latency includes that round trip.

method.ground_truth: exact search (sequential scan, ORDER BY cosine distance, play_id), verified against NumPy
method.query_sample: 200 plays per split with the smallest sha256('retrieval-benchmark-v1:<play_id>')
method.recall_at_k: |exact top-k ∩ approximate top-k| / |exact top-k|, averaged over queries
method.effective_ef_search: max(ef_search, k): the store raises ef_search to k so the index can return k rows
method.latency: warm cache; search_statement = the nearest-neighbour SQL statement round trip; store_call = the whole read-only transaction (embedding-set and query lookups, candidate count when filtered, EXPLAIN for approximate, the search)
method.ef_selection_rule: keep pgvector's default (40) if its unfiltered mean recall@10 >= 0.99; otherwise the smallest grid value that meets it

filtered.query_sample: 50 plays per split, salt 'retrieval-benchmark-v1-filtered'; filters derived from each query play's own context

ingestion.scope: load() into an empty scratch schema: validation, cosine reference, COPY, upsert with the HNSW index maintained incrementally, ANALYZE

endpoints.scope: FastAPI app in the benchmark process (Starlette TestClient): validation, database transaction, play summaries, evidence, JSON. No network hop between client and API; the database is reached over localhost TCP.

examples.selection: weakest nearest neighbour in the benchmark sample

offline_embedding_quality.note: Measured in Phase 3 (label agreement of nearest neighbours, test queries against the train corpus). A different measurement from ANN recall; not re-run here.
